title: The Playlist of Lake Minnow
author: Lena Dravenmoor
blurb: Wendell Joubert, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
